user.title: Training
user.description: Creates a secret webhook address and a token for the REST API automation of Health Auto Export. Both are shown after setup and later under Configure.

reconfigure.title: Training
reconfigure.description: Creates a new webhook address or a new token. Saved workouts are kept. Afterwards enter the new values in Health Auto Export; until then it cannot deliver workouts.

data_description.new_webhook: The old address stops working at once.
data_description.new_token: The old token stops working at once.

abort.reconfigure_unchanged: Nothing selected; address and token are unchanged.

init.title: Training

data.route_users: Other accounts that may see routes

data_description.keep_details: Older workouts keep their summary; route and charts are deleted. One hour of walking with one GPS point per second needs about 170 KB.
data_description.require_token: Rejects calls without the header above (HTTP 401). Turn it on only after the header is entered in Health Auto Export.
data_description.route_users: Administrators always see routes, charts and the GPX export. Other accounts only see the summary (the same values as the sensors) unless they are selected here.

delete_workout.name: Delete workout
delete_workout.description: Deletes a workout with route and charts. Its ID is blocked, so Health Auto Export cannot add it again; undo with Accept deleted workout again.

workout_id.name: Workout ID
workout_id.description: Attribute workout_id of the sensor Latest workout or of the event New workout.

undelete_workout.name: Accept deleted workout again
undelete_workout.description: Removes a deleted workout from the block list. It returns with the next upload from Health Auto Export that contains it.

not_loaded.message: The Training integration is not set up or not loaded.

workout_not_deleted.message: The workout {workout_id} is not on the list of deleted workouts.
